name: models3d_generate
description: Image-to-3D GLB. Upload external images first. Animate with `models3d_rig`. Models: tripo-p1 default, tripo-v31, trellis-2.

textureQuality.description: Tripo: none, standard default, detailed v31 only.

faceLimit.description: Tripo faces. tripo-p1: 100..20,000 (default 10,000); tripo-v31: up to 2,000,000. Optional — omit for the model default.

folderReference.description: Optional project/folder reference from `folders_list` to place results in. Omit for the default.
